svg.title: How Hoista works
svg.desc: Coding agents connect over stdio, chat apps over HTTP with OAuth, and you through the desktop app or the hoist CLI over a local socket. All of them reach hoistd, the engine, which runs on your computer or as a remote in your own account. hoistd checks each caller's access, keeps its state in SQLite, works with your providers through their APIs and CLIs, and reads a provider token only for the call that needs it.
